basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and modder since the early days of Minecraft, ModdedMiner1975 hails from the bustling city of Portland, Oregon. With a background in computer science, they have spent countless hours tinkering with game mods and exploring virtual worlds. When not online, they work as a freelance software developer, often taking breaks to hike in the nearby forests with their partner. They are active on Reddit mostly in the evenings and weekends, sharing insights and engaging in discussions on various mod-related topics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possessing a degree in computer science from Oregon State University, ModdedMiner1975 has honed their skills through both formal education and self-teaching. Their expertise spans game development, modding, and performance optimization, acquired through years of experimenting with different mods and contributing to the modding community.
